title: Battle of Pendragon
description: Capture the imperial capital at Pendragon (-117° longitude, 37.5° latitude) in the final E.U. offensive.
implementationNotes: Implement the regional battle in a separate module. Register its actual ID in E.scenarios.byId, then change the matching entry's scenarioId in dist/war-campaign.js. Keep this metadata and the registry synchronized. Do not overwrite an existing standalone scenario or change campaign tiers.
